item.title: Japan’s Ami Nakai surges into Olympic lead after short program as US struggles
item.description: MILAN — Ami Nakai and Japanese teammate Kaori Sakamoto upstaged Alysa Liu and the rest of the “Blade Angels” on Tuesday night.

item.title: Sugarloaf Twp. Supervisors table ordinance regulating data centers
item.description: SUGARLOAF TWP. — Sugarloaf Township Supervisors, at its monthly meeting Tuesday, tabled an ordinance regulating data centers because they want more time to think about the proposed changes.

item.title: Republicans hold petition-signing in Wilkes-Barre Twp. for May primary election
item.description: WILKES-BARRE TWP. — Republicans gathered at the Wilkes-Barre Twp. Fire Hall on Tuesday evening for petition-signing for candidates running in the 2026 Primary Election. The event was sponsored by the Republican Women of Luzerne County (RWLC).

item.title: Engaging in the economics of energy: Roundtable focuses on electricity supplies, rising utility bills
item.description: Residents, organizations, and political groups joined together in downtown Wilkes-Barre to find answers to two questions.

item.title: $2.1M HVAC upgrade approved for Lehman-Jackson Elementary
item.description: The Lake-Lehman school board approved a proposal for a $2,120,486 HVAC project in Lehman-Jackson Elementary at a meeting Tuesday.

item.title: District 2 Basketball: Lake-Lehman girls win, get rematch with Holy Redeemer
item.description: Lake-Lehman pulled away in the second half as the Black Knights defeated Western Wayne 51-35 Tuesday night in a District 2 Class 3A girls basketball quarterfinal game.

item.title: H.S. Girls Basketball: Stambaugh scores 40 as Seminary routs Trail
item.description: KINGSTON — Wyoming Seminary’s Ella Stambaugh showed Tuesday night why she led the entire Wyoming Valley Conference in scoring this season.

item.title: H.S. Boys Basketball: Warriors hold off Tunkhannock in D2-4A quarterfinals
item.description: EXETER — A comfortable Wyoming Area lead for most of the night became decidedly uncomfortable down the stretch in Tuesday night’s District 2 playoff opener.

item.title: Noah Feldman: Grok fakes are a digital assault. Make it a crime
item.description: The horrifying episode in which Elon Musk’s Grok chatbot generated and posted millions of sexualized images of real people, including women and children, has a clear lesson: It should be illegal to use anyone’s photograph to create a fake image intended to depict that person.
